scenes.say: A community includes living organisms. With the non-living surroundings and their interactions it forms an ecosystem. Edaphic means soil-related. Soil texture, pH and moisture affect which organisms survive there.

Tropical rainforest has abundant rainfall and many plant species. It occurs in humid southern Nigeria, including parts of the southwest. The lithosphere is Earth’s rigid outer layer. It includes the crust and the uppermost mantle.

Temperature, light and water are abiotic factors. They are non-living features of the environment. Some older cooling systems used chlorofluorocarbons, or CFCs, as refrigerants. Leaks or disposal could release them into the atmosphere.

JAMB asks which elements make an ecosystem, where tropical rainforest occurs in Nigeria and which older equipment released CFCs. Blue arrows show movement of soil water or refrigerant vapour in the examples.

quickCheck.feedback: Edaphic factors are soil properties that affect organisms, such as soil moisture or pH.
